risks.title: Availability of ground lease investment opportunities
risks.score_rationale: The ground lease transaction market and availability of investment opportunities may not meet the company's growth objectives, limiting its ability to deploy capital and generate revenue.

risks.title: Credit risks and counterparty concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant credit risk due to concentration of revenues among a few large tenants and the possibility of payment default, particularly on office assets with low occupancy.

risks.title: Office real estate sector risks
risks.score_rationale: Rising interest rates have severely impacted the office sector with high vacancy rates and reduced liquidity, directly affecting revenues and ground rent coverage on office properties in the portfolio.

risks.title: Interest rate and tenant financing risks
risks.score_rationale: Higher interest rates have increased mortgage financing costs for tenants, which are critical to the growth of the ground lease market, and may attract new competitors reducing yields.

risks.title: Inflation risks and capped rent adjustments
risks.score_rationale: Although most leases include inflation adjustments, these are typically capped between 3.0% and 3.5%, which may not offset inflation above the cap.

risks.title: Lease renewal and property repositioning risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may be unable to renew expiring ground leases or reposition properties on favorable terms, impacting portfolio growth and valuation.

risks.title: Operational risks of Park Hotels portfolio
risks.score_rationale: The company became responsible for operating two hotel properties in January 2026 following disputes with the tenant, despite having no prior hotel operating experience, creating material operational and financial risks.

risks.title: Tenant rights and limitations on residual value
risks.score_rationale: Certain tenant rights under ground leases may limit the value and residual rights the company can realize upon lease expiration or property sale.
